question:

I thought of this idea / just when you called / me yesterday.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• Each part of the sentence is correctly framed and adheres to the rules of standard English grammar.

• Hence, the correct choice is **No error**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
